narration: One night, Glimmersnout the tiny golden fox looked up... and the whole sky was EMPTY!
Then she spotted something — a tiny trail of glowing crumbs leading into the Whispering Woods!
She followed the trail deeper and deeper... until she found a gigantic sleeping cloud monster — and he'd accidentally swallowed ALL the stars!
Glimmersnout had an idea! She tickled the cloud monster's big fluffy tummy... and he giggled SO hard the stars all burst out — zooming back into the sky!
The sky was full of stars again! The cloud monster woke up, looked around... and gave Glimmersnout the biggest, fluffiest hug EVER.
But wait — Glimmersnout counted the stars... and ONE was still missing. Where could it be?! Come back tomorrow to find out!
on_screen_text: One star missing... 🔍⭐ Come back tomorrow!
